ui.hub.browse.action.trying.note: Same control as action.try_again, disabled and aria-busy while the retry runs. U+2026, not three periods.
ui.hub.browse.action.trying.role: button label while the retry is in flight
ui.hub.browse.action.trying.tone: plain; the app's ellipsis progress idiom

ui.hub.browse.card.download_aria.note: {name} is the agent's hub display name (escaped display bytes), never translated or slugified. Must keep containing the visible card.get word where the language allows.
ui.hub.browse.card.download_aria.role: accessible name for the card's download button

ui.hub.browse.card.downloads_tooltip.note: A count label, not a verb: the count beside it is record data. Plural form is irrelevant — the message is the bare noun on purpose.

ui.hub.browse.card.favourite.aria_unknow.note: The viewer's favourite state could not be read, so the control never claims 'not favourited'. Explains an unknown rather than a state.
ui.hub.browse.card.favourite.aria_unknow.role: accessible name of a disabled star

ui.hub.browse.card.favourite.tooltip_fav.note: Filled star; the press removes the favourite.

ui.hub.browse.card.favourite.tooltip_sig.note: Signed-out viewer. Radient is a product name and stays English.

ui.hub.browse.card.favourite.tooltip_unf.note: Empty star; the press adds the favourite.

ui.hub.browse.card.favourite.tooltip_unk.note: Explains a failed viewer-state read; never asserts the agent is unfavourited.

ui.hub.browse.card.get.note: The card's only labelled action; downloads the agent to this machine. Keep it short: the button sits in a narrow footer beside a count.
ui.hub.browse.card.get.role: button label on an agent card

ui.hub.browse.card.like.aria_unknown.note: Mirror of card.favourite.aria_unknown for likes: a failed read is not 'not liked'.
ui.hub.browse.card.like.aria_unknown.role: accessible name of a disabled heart

ui.hub.browse.card.like.tooltip_liked.note: Filled heart; the press removes the like.

ui.hub.browse.card.like.tooltip_unliked.note: Empty heart; the press adds the like.

ui.hub.browse.card.unknown_author.note: The hub sent no author name; the line prints this instead of a name. Sentence case.
ui.hub.browse.card.unknown_author.role: inline fallback in the provenance line

ui.hub.browse.card.updated.note: {age} is the COMPLETE strict relative age including its 'ago'/'in' wording, formatted with the active locale's plural rules by the shared hub age helper. Do not append another preposition. Keep the leading lowercase word before the placeholder.

ui.hub.browse.details.back_aria.note: Returns to the Agent Hub list. 'Agent Hub' is a surface name, title case.
ui.hub.browse.details.back_aria.role: accessible name for an icon-only back arrow

ui.hub.browse.details.catalogue_no_answe.note: Passed to the shared backend-error mapper, which appends the transport detail after it. Radient is a product name.
ui.hub.browse.details.catalogue_no_answe.role: base sentence inside a danger alert

ui.hub.browse.details.created.note: {age} is a complete relative age including its preposition; {date} is an already-formatted calendar date. The parentheses and the colon are part of the message.
ui.hub.browse.details.created.role: metadata line on the detail page

ui.hub.browse.details.created_by.note: {author} is assembled by the caller: the name, plus the email in parentheses only when the hub sent one. Never concatenate the email here.
ui.hub.browse.details.created_by.role: metadata line on the detail page

ui.hub.browse.details.delist_aria.note: Opens the delist confirmation. Should contain the same verb as details.delist_confirm so speech control finds it.
ui.hub.browse.details.delist_aria.role: accessible name for the owner-only delist button

ui.hub.browse.details.delist_body.note: {name} is the agent's hub display name (escaped display bytes). Says the removal is immediate and that re-uploading restores it, so severity is explicit. Two sentences, wraps freely, no width cap.

ui.hub.browse.details.delist_confirm.note: Commits the delist. Not a danger button: re-uploading undoes it.

ui.hub.browse.details.delist_title.note: Names the object acted on. Sentence case; the question mark is the app's confirmation convention.

ui.hub.browse.details.delist_tooltip.note: 'Permanently' describes removal from the public listing, not account deletion. Agent Hub is a surface name.

ui.hub.browse.details.delisting.note: Labelled by the spinner while the delist request is in flight; the confirming button is disabled meanwhile.
ui.hub.browse.details.delisting.role: status text announced while the request runs

ui.hub.browse.details.download_aria.note: Detail-page counterpart of card.download_aria; here the name is generic because the button sits under the agent's own title.
ui.hub.browse.details.download_aria.role: accessible name for the icon-only download button

ui.hub.browse.details.download_tooltip.note: Says the agent is copied to this computer, which is the promise the action keeps.

ui.hub.browse.details.failure.delist.note: One of four per-action headlines; never a generic 'something went wrong'.
ui.hub.browse.details.failure.delist.role: alert headline after a failed delist
ui.hub.browse.details.failure.delist.tone: plain, names what did not happen

ui.hub.browse.details.failure.download.note: Says nothing started rather than 'failed', which matches what the user saw.
ui.hub.browse.details.failure.download.role: alert headline after a failed download
ui.hub.browse.details.failure.download.tone: plain, names what did not happen

ui.hub.browse.details.failure.favourite.note: Mirror of details.failure.like for the star.
ui.hub.browse.details.failure.favourite.role: alert headline after a failed favourite press
ui.hub.browse.details.failure.favourite.tone: plain, names what did not happen

ui.hub.browse.details.failure.like.note: Uses the noun the UI uses for this control; the retry sits beneath it.
ui.hub.browse.details.failure.like.role: alert headline after a failed like press
ui.hub.browse.details.failure.like.tone: plain, names what did not happen

ui.hub.browse.details.last_modified.note: Same shape as details.created with the last-modified timestamp.
ui.hub.browse.details.last_modified.role: metadata line on the detail page

ui.hub.browse.details.load_failed_title.note: The whole record could not be loaded (distinct from a failed action on a loaded record).

ui.hub.browse.details.not_found.note: The route's agent id resolved to nothing; retrying would not help, so there is no control beside it.

ui.hub.browse.details.sign_in_hint.note: Shared by both controls on the detail page; the same sentence the card uses per control. Radient stays English.
ui.hub.browse.details.sign_in_hint.role: tooltip on like/favourite while signed out

ui.hub.browse.details.unknown_author.note: The hub sent no author name. Unlike card.unknown_author this one is a fragment inside details.created_by, so it carries no article.
ui.hub.browse.details.unknown_author.role: inline fallback inside the author line

ui.hub.browse.details.viewer_unknown.note: One failed read for the whole page: says why no viewer state is shown instead of letting every control read as 'not liked'.
ui.hub.browse.details.viewer_unknown.role: status line in an output element

ui.hub.browse.pager.aria.note: Default only; callers whose list is not agents pass their own translated label (the skills library does).
ui.hub.browse.pager.aria.role: accessible name for the pager nav

ui.hub.browse.pager.next.note: Steps one page forward; paired with a chevron icon.

ui.hub.browse.pager.previous.note: Steps one page back; paired with a chevron icon.
